description: Source code for FPGA driver for iCE40 FPGA in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for loading bitstreams via SPI or GPIO, managing FPGA state, and handling hardware-specific quirks.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_crc_to_str
methods.description: Converts a CRC32 value to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_delay
methods.description: Performs a calibrated delay loop to achieve specific timing.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_send_clocks
methods.description: Sends a specified number of clock pulses via GPIO.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_spi_send_data
methods.description: Sends data over GPIO bitbanged SPI.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_load_gpio
methods.description: Loads FPGA bitstream via GPIO bitbanging method.

methods.name: fpga_ice40_load
methods.description: Generic load function calling the configured load method.
